frontmatter.sidebar_description: Export inventory items with filtering capabilities.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `exportInventoryItemsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow exports inventory items matching the specified filters. The exported
CSV file includes the inventory levels of each item per stock location. It's used by the
[Export Inventory Items Admin API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin/inventory-items/export-inventory-items).

This workflow doesn't return the exported inventory items. Instead, it sends a notification to the admin
users that they can download the exported inventory items. Learn more in the [API Reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin/inventory-items/export-inventory-items).

steps.name: exportInventoryItemsStep
steps.description:
This step exports inventory items to a CSV file based on the provided filters.
The exported file includes the inventory levels of each item per stock location.

steps.name: notifyOnFailureStep
steps.description:
This step sends one or more notification when a workflow fails. This
step can be used in the beginning of a workflow so that, when the workflow fails,
the step's compensation function is triggered to send the notification.

steps.name: useQueryGraphStep
steps.description:
This step fetches data across modules using the Query.

Learn more in the [Query documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query).

steps.name: sendNotificationsStep
steps.description: This step sends one or more notifications.
